q: Who can join the Young Pro Ministry?
Who is this ministry for?
Can I join?
Sino pwede sumali sa Young Pro?
Para kanino ba 'tong ministry na 'to?
Pwede ba ako pumunta?
a_en: Everyone is welcome — there's a seat saved for you. We're the young professionals (and fresh grads, and folks still figuring life out) of Faith Temple Baptist Church. Whether you're rock-solid in your faith or just curious, fresh out of school or deep into your career, you belong here. Just show up to a fellowship or YPGT, or email us first at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.
a_tl: Welcome ang lahat — may nakareserbang upuan para sa'yo dito. Kami ang young professionals (kasama na ang mga fresh grad at yung mga kababalik-balikan pa lang sa buhay) ng Faith Temple Baptist Church. Matibay man ang faith mo o curious ka lang, kaka-graduate ka man o matagal nang nagtatrabaho — belong ka dito. Sumipot ka lang sa fellowship o YPGT, o mag-email muna sa amin sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.

q: What age is the Young Pro Ministry for?
Is there an age limit?
Am I too old to join?
Ilang taon ba dapat para sumali?
May age limit ba?
Young pro ba talaga ang dating ko?
a_en: We're a community for young professionals — generally young adults who are working, fresh out of school, or just starting their careers. We don't gatekeep with a strict age cutoff, so if 'young professional' feels like you, you're in the right place. Not sure if you fit? Message us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com and we'll happily welcome you.
a_tl: Para kami sa young professionals — kadalasan mga young adults na nagtatrabaho, kaka-graduate, o nagsisimula pa lang sa career. Wala kaming mahigpit na age cutoff, kaya kung pakiramdam mo 'young professional' ka, tamang-tama ka dito. Hindi sigurado kung kasya ka? Mag-message ka lang sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com at masaya naming tatanggapin.

q: I'm a fresh grad — can I still join?
I'm a student still figuring things out, is that okay?
I don't have a job yet, can I come?
Fresh grad lang ako, pwede pa rin ba?
Estudyante pa ako, okay lang ba?
Wala pa akong trabaho, pwede ba?
a_en: Absolutely — fresh grads, students still figuring it out, people between jobs or just starting their careers are all welcome. You don't need a job title or a settled life to belong here; you just need to show up as you are. Come to a fellowship or email us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.
a_tl: Syempre — welcome ang mga fresh grad, estudyanteng nag-iisip pa kung saan papunta, mga nasa pagitan ng trabaho, o nagsisimula pa lang. Hindi mo kailangan ng job title o ayos na buhay para mabilang dito; kailangan mo lang sumipot as you are. Punta ka sa fellowship o mag-email sa amin sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.

keywords: do i need to be a member
q: Is the Young Pro Ministry only for FTB members?
Do I need to be a member of Faith Temple Baptist Church?
I go to a different church — can I still join?
Para lang ba 'to sa members ng FTB?
Kailangan ko bang maging member ng FTB?
Iba ang simbahan ko, pwede pa rin ba?
a_en: Not at all — you don't need to be an FTB member to join. We welcome visitors, friends, and people from other churches too. Whether you call FTB home or you're just dropping by, there's a seat for you. Reach out anytime at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.
a_tl: Hinding-hindi — hindi mo kailangang maging member ng FTB para makasali. Welcome ang mga bisita, mga kaibigan, at maging yung galing sa ibang simbahan. FTB man ang tawag mo sa 'home' mo o dumadaan ka lang, may upuan para sa'yo. I-message mo lang kami anytime sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.

keywords: do i need to be christian
q: Do I need to be a Christian to join?
I'm not a Christian — am I still welcome?
Can non-Christians join?
Kailangan ko bang maging Christian para sumali?
Hindi ako kristiyano, welcome pa rin ba ako?
Pwede ba ang hindi pa sumasampalataya?
a_en: No, you don't need to be a Christian to come — you're genuinely welcome whether you're rock-solid in your faith or just curious and exploring. We're not here to pressure you; we're here for real conversations, the Word, kape, and friendship. Come as you are, and bring your questions.
a_tl: Hindi, hindi mo kailangang maging Christian para makasali — totoong welcome ka, matibay man ang faith mo o curious ka lang at nag-eexplore. Wala kaming pino-pressure; nandito kami para sa totoong kwentuhan, sa Salita ng Diyos, kape, at pagkakaibigan. Halika as you are, at dalhin mo na rin ang mga tanong mo.

keywords: what if i don't know anyone
q: I've never been before — is it okay to just show up?
I'm nervous about coming as a first-timer.
What if I don't know anyone there?
First time ko, okay lang bang sumipot lang?
Kabado ako kasi first timer, ano gagawin ko?
Paano kung walang akong kakilala doon?
a_en: First-timers are some of our favorite people — just show up, come as you are, no performance needed. If you'd like, email us first and we'll tell you exactly where and when, and someone will be looking out for you so you're never left standing alone. Reach us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.
a_tl: Paborito namin ang mga first-timer — sumipot ka lang, halika as you are, walang kailangang i-perform. Kung gusto mo, mag-email ka muna sa amin at sasabihin namin kung saan at kelan eksakto, at may maghahanap sa'yo para hindi ka kailanman maiwang mag-isa. I-reach mo kami sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com.

q: Can I bring a friend?
Can I invite people who aren't part of the ministry?
Is it okay to bring my barkada?
Pwede ba akong magdala ng kaibigan?
Pwede ko bang isama ang barkada ko?
Okay lang bang mag-invite ng iba?
a_en: Yes, please do — bring a friend, bring your whole barkada! Everyone's welcome here, and some of our gatherings (like Friend Day and the YPGT outings) are built exactly for inviting friends along. The more, the merrier.
a_tl: Oo, sige lang — magdala ka ng kaibigan, isama mo na ang buong barkada! Welcome ang lahat dito, at may mga gathering kami (gaya ng Friend Day at ang mga YPGT outing) na talagang para sa pag-imbita ng mga kaibigan. Mas marami, mas masaya.

q: I'm just curious and want to check it out — is that allowed?
Can I come without committing to anything?
I just want to see what it's like first.
Curious lang ako, pwede bang tingnan muna?
Pwede bang pumunta ng walang commitment?
Gusto ko lang munang makita kung anong meron.
a_en: Of course — curiosity is more than welcome, no commitment required. Come check us out, sit in on a fellowship, hang at a YPGT, and see if it feels like home. There's zero pressure here — just kape, the Word, and a family that's genuinely glad you came.
a_tl: Syempre — welcong-welcome ang pagiging curious, walang kailangang i-commit. Halika, tingnan mo kami, umupo ka sa isang fellowship, mag-hang ka sa YPGT, at tingnan kung para kang nasa bahay. Zero pressure dito — kape, ang Salita ng Diyos, at isang pamilyang totoong natutuwang dumating ka.

q: I don't live in Quezon City — can I still join?

a_en: You're welcome no matter where you're coming from — we don't limit it to one area. Our fellowships and YPGTs gather at the church in Novaliches, Quezon City (and outings happen at different spots), so if you can make it out, we'd love to have you. Email us at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com and we'll help you plan.
a_tl: Welcome ka saan ka man galing — hindi namin nililimita sa isang lugar lang. Mag-email ka lang sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com at tutulungan ka naming mag-plano.
